messages:
Alex M: Heads up — during quantized bring-up of hf/gpt-mini-xyz the Redwood streaming runtime is cutting streams early for a handful of prompts. Repro script attached.
Priya S: thx, can you paste a minimal log snippet?
Alex M: pasted logs:
```
[INFO] stream chunk: 'def add(a, b):'
[INFO] stream chunk: '    return a + b'
[INFO] stream chunk: ''
[INFO] stream closed by runtime (early_eos)
```
Marcos: interesting — looks like tokenizer emitted multiple EOS tokens in a row. HF tokenizer sometimes returns ['', ''] depending on special tokens mapping. Could be conversion issue (tokenizer.json vs config.json merge).
Emily R: which fields in config.json are set? eos_token vs unk vs additional_special_tokens?
Alex M: model config.json contains "eos_token": "</s>" but tokenizer added "<|endoftext|>" as an added_token. During our HF->Redwood conversion we preserved both and didn't reconcile ids. After quantization the model logits sometimes assign high prob to both EOS ids in succession.
Nikhil: quantization itself is unlikely to change token ids, but our tokenizer serialization path was dropping special_tokens_map in some conversions — that can lead to duplicate canonical eos strings mapping to different ids.
CI Bot: perf/regression job: https://ci.internal/reports/rl/eval/1234 shows a +6% perplexity regression on the code-completion eval for the converted model.
Priya S: can you share the minimal reproduce command so we can run locally with HF tokenizer + our converted artifacts?
Alex M: yes:
```
python reproduce.py --model converted/gpt-mini-xyz --prompt "Write a function to add two numbers" --stream
```
Marcos: quick runtime workaround: treat consecutive EOS token ids as a single EOS event. Implementation sketch: keep last_token_was_eos flag and only close the stream on the first eos after a non-eos. Also ensure we flush partial chunks when eos hits even if additional eos tokens arrive.
Emily R: that masks the root cause (mismapped special tokens), but it reduces customer impact quickly. We should do both: runtime guard + fix conversion.
Nikhil: pushed a draft PR (https://git.internal/pr/289) — changes: 1) tokenizer conversion keeps HF special_tokens_map as authoritative, 2) prefer tokenizer.json if present, 3) add unit test for multi-eos sequences.
Priya S: test plan for rollout?
Alex M: plan:
1) unit tests for consecutive EOS handling in tokenizer conversion and runtime
2) end-to-end streaming integration test (simulate HF tokenizer output with double EOS)
3) run eval suite pre/post patch to confirm perplexity regression gone
4) 1% canary traffic in Dedicated with automatic fallback to baseline model on early_termination > 0.5%
Marcos: I'll take the conversion + integration tests today. If needed we can hotfix runtime and deploy to staging.
Emily R: cool — can we also add an eval that specifically measures early_stop rate and streaming chunk continuity? add to nightly.
Alex M: good idea, will add metric.
CI Bot: deploy to staging triggered by marcos (branch: marcos/eos-conversion-fix) — build 4521.
Marcos: quick note: during local testing the HF tokenizer decode sometimes inserts an extra whitespace when two eos tokens are adjacent, which caused some downstream evals to look like content (we should strip/normalize).
Nikhil: added a normalizer to decode path to collapse repeated eos strings and trim whitespace. Patch in PR.
Priya S: thanks everyone. Keep updates here. If anyone hits a customer report, escalate to oncall. :thumbsup:
Alex M: thanks all — will follow up with postmortem if this reaches prod.
